item.title: Bondi says all Epstein files are released. Lawmakers say she's lying.
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi told Congress on Saturday that the Justice Department has released all documents required by the Epstein Files Transparency Act. item.title: Steve Bannon sued over MAGA crypto scheme
item.description: In December 2023, Steve Bannon and Boris Epshteyn allegedly activated a backdoor mechanism in a cryptocurrency they controlled, freezing investor wallets while exempting their own. A class action lawsuit filed February 12 in DC federal court alleges the pair had secretly acquired the token — called "Let's Go Brandon Coin," or $FJB — in December 2021, paying nothing. — Read the rest The post Steve Bannon sued over MAGA crypto scheme appeared first on Boing Boing.
